package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/ryotapoi/somniloq/internal/core"
	_ "modernc.org/sqlite"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

func must(e error) {
	if e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
}
func createControl() {
	path := ".tmp/legacy-show/normal.db"
	os.Remove(path)
	d, e := core.OpenDB(path)
	if e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
	defer d.Close()
	input := core.Input{Source: core.SourceCodex, Root: "/tmp/legacy-show-normal"}
	id, e := d.EnsureInput(input)
	if e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
	if e = d.UpsertSession(id, core.SessionMeta{Source: core.SourceCodex, SessionID: "normal"}, "now"); e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
	for n := 1; n <= 20; n++ {
		if e = d.InsertMessage(id, core.NormalizedMessage{Source: core.SourceCodex, SessionID: "normal", UUID: fmt.Sprint(n), Role: "user", Number: n, Content: strings.Repeat("x", 128)}); e != nil {
			panic(e)
		}
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(".tmp/legacy-show/normal.ref", []byte(core.RootREF(core.InputKey(input.Source, input.Root), input.Source, "normal")), 0600); e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(".tmp/legacy-show/normal.toml", []byte("db = 'normal.db'\n[[inputs]]\nsource = 'codex'\nroot = 'logs'\n"), 0600); e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
}
func main() {
	createControl()
	root := ".tmp/legacy-show"
	digest := strings.Repeat("a", 64)
	for _, total := range []int{1000, 100000} {
		path := filepath.Join(root, fmt.Sprintf("%d.db", total))
		os.Remove(path)
		d, e := core.OpenDB(path)
		must(e)
		must(d.Close())
		db, e := sql.Open("sqlite", path)
		must(e)
		tx, e := db.Begin()
		must(e)
		ss, e := tx.Prepare(`INSERT INTO legacy_sessions(snapshot_sha256,source,session_id,imported_at) VALUES(?,'codex',?,'now')`)
		must(e)
		ms, e := tx.Prepare(`INSERT INTO legacy_messages(snapshot_sha256,uuid,source,session_id,role,content,number) VALUES(?,?,'codex',?,'user',?,?)`)
		must(e)
		for i := 0; i < total/20; i++ {
			id := fmt.Sprintf("s%d", i)
			_, e = ss.Exec(digest, id)
			must(e)
			for n := 1; n <= 20; n++ {
				_, e = ms.Exec(digest, fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", id, n), id, strings.Repeat("x", 128), n)
				must(e)
			}
		}
		must(tx.Commit())
		must(ss.Close())
		must(ms.Close())
		must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, fmt.Sprintf("%d.toml", total)), []byte(fmt.Sprintf("db = '%d.db'\n[[inputs]]\nsource = 'codex'\nroot = 'logs'\n", total)), 0600))
		for _, count := range []int{1, 8} {
			for round := 0; round < 6; round++ {
				sides := []string{"before", "after"}
				if round%2 == 1 {
					sides = []string{"after", "before"}
				}
				for _, side := range sides {
					where := `source=? AND session_id=?`
					if side == "after" {
						where = `snapshot_sha256=? AND ` + where
					}
					start := time.Now()
					got := 0
					for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
						args := []any{"codex", fmt.Sprintf("s%d", i)}
						if side == "after" {
							args = append([]any{digest}, args...)
						}
						q := `SELECT uuid,role,content,COALESCE(timestamp,''),'null',number,'',0,'','legacy_saved',legacy_rowid FROM legacy_messages WHERE ` + where + ` AND (source IN ('codex','claude_code') OR COALESCE(is_sidechain,0)=0) ORDER BY number`
						if round == 0 && count == 1 {
							plans, e := db.Query("EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN "+q, args...)
							must(e)
							for plans.Next() {
								var id, parent, unused int
								var detail string
								must(plans.Scan(&id, &parent, &unused, &detail))
								fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, total, side, detail)
							}
							must(plans.Close())
							plans, e = db.Query("EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT count(*) FROM legacy_messages WHERE "+where+` AND (source IN ('codex','claude_code') OR COALESCE(is_sidechain,0)=0)`, args...)
							must(e)
							for plans.Next() {
								var id, parent, unused int
								var detail string
								must(plans.Scan(&id, &parent, &unused, &detail))
								fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, total, side, "count", detail)
							}
							must(plans.Close())
							start = time.Now()
						}
						var counted int
						must(db.QueryRow("SELECT count(*) FROM legacy_messages WHERE "+where+` AND (source IN ('codex','claude_code') OR COALESCE(is_sidechain,0)=0)`, args...).Scan(&counted))
						if counted != 20 {
							panic(counted)
						}
						rows, e := db.Query(q, args...)
						must(e)
						for rows.Next() {
							var a, b, c, d, f, g, h, k string
							var n, j int
							var l int64
							must(rows.Scan(&a, &b, &c, &d, &f, &n, &g, &j, &h, &k, &l))
							got++
						}
						must(rows.Err())
						must(rows.Close())
					}
					must(json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"kind": "retrieval", "total": total, "refs": count, "round": round, "side": side, "ms": float64(time.Since(start).Nanoseconds()) / 1e6, "rows": got}))
				}
			}
		}
		must(db.Close())
	}
}
